note: Precision of the architectural-sense checks (RC14) per rule, judged one finding at a time (a finding is right when it points at a real error of the reading, false when the reading follows its drawing); a rule below the threshold, or never judged, writes its findings with severity info. The tables were tuned on the same readings: in-sample.
readings: the merged-tree readings of real01-real21 (no real05) and synthetic-01, 03-07 (regress_merged, 5 Nov 2026), and fresh CPU readings of synthetic-08 to synthetic-22 at this commit's parent; 41 readings, 118 findings judged
project_status: accepted = results/reading_truth/ status accepted (real01-04, 06, 10, 15, 21 and every synthetic project); open = real09, 11, 13, 14, 16, 18, 19, 20; partial = real07 (drifted), real17 (L-1 accepted), real08, real12

first_pass.note: the first run of the rules as specified, before any tuning, on the accepted projects only; judged the same way

room_type_area.false: synthetic-03's two 14 m2 KİLER (a basement store), synthetic-07's 43.5 m2 bedroom with its 43.5 m2 text, real10's 13.3 m2 lift machine room on the roof terrace

frame_walls_and_paper_rooms.false: 24: tight region boxes put real outer walls on the box edges (real02, real04, synthetic-07, -08, -13, -18, -21) and a roof terrace filling its box

circulation.false: 17: real03's seven 0.24-0.35 m2 slivers, real21's four AYDINLIK light wells, synthetic floors that are one flat with no stair drawn

tuning: frame walls need no opening and at most 2 other walls ending on them (a building's outer walls carry openings and inner walls end on them)
a room covering most of the region box is paper only with 2 or more other rooms' labels in it
a drawn area text within 10 % of the face exempts a room from the type-area ranges (the drawing gives it that size)
KİLER is judged as a storage room; light wells from 0.5 m2; bathrooms from 1.0 m2 (real14 draws 1.31 m2 en-suites); kitchens from 3.0 m2
a lift's room on a roof terrace floor is its machine room
a small room's face over 2.0 times its maximum goes to rule 2 (real18's fire lobby is 99.4 m2, 2.48 times 40)
the door rule asks only rooms people use every day (dwelling rooms, baths, halls, stairs, a lift, a garage), never faces under 1 m2, never a room with a stair standing in it
a group of rooms holding every entered room of its floor is the whole floor (the stair rule's question)
with 3 walls per label or more only the labels inside the walls' hull count as outside every room (site notes outside the building)
